company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

status.x-ask: What status should this plan show?

last_updated.description: Date the user says the plan was last updated.
last_updated.x-ask: What date should we use for last updated?

plan_format.description: traditional for lenders and investors, or lean for internal planning. The section headings stay the same either way.
plan_format.x-ask: Is this a traditional plan for a lender or investor, or a lean plan for internal use?

audience.description: Who will read the plan, such as a lender, an investor, or the team.

location.description: Headquarters and where the company does business, if the user stated it.
location.x-ask: Where is the company based, and where does it do business?

legal_structure.description: Legal structure the user stated, such as sole proprietorship, LLC, or S corp.

executive_summary.description: Short summary written only from facts already in this fill: concept, customer, offer, advantage, objectives, and any funding or revenue figures the user supplied.
executive_summary.x-ask: What must a reader understand before the rest of the plan?

business_concept.description: What the company does, in the user's words.

business_model.description: How the company sells, such as B2C, DTC, B2B, C2C, or C2B, only if the user named it.
business_model.x-ask: Which business model is this: B2C, DTC, B2B, C2C, or C2B?

industry.description: Industry or niche the user named.
industry.x-ask: What industry or niche is this in?

competitive_advantage.description: What the user says the company has that alternatives do not. Do not invent a differentiator.

mission.description: Why the company exists, in the user's words.

values.x-ask: Which values should the plan list?

objectives.description: Short-term and longer-term objectives the user stated. Include a metric or deadline only when the user gave one.
objectives.x-ask: What do you want to achieve in the next year, and in the next one to five years?

horizon.description: When the objective applies, such as next year or one to five years.

text.description: The objective, including a measure and deadline only if the user supplied them.

team.description: People the user named. Do not add anyone they did not name, and do not invent credentials or pay.
team.x-ask: Who is on the leadership team, what does each person do, and what background should the plan include?

background.description: Credentials or background the user stated for this person.

products_and_services.description: What the company sells or plans to offer, who it serves, and any launches or intellectual property the user described.
products_and_services.x-ask: What do you sell or plan to offer, and who is it for?

pricing.description: Prices and the reason for them, only when the user gave the numbers and the rationale.
pricing.x-ask: What is the price of each offer, and what informed that price?

sourcing.description: How the offer is made or sourced, including suppliers the user named and risks they named.
sourcing.x-ask: How do you source or produce what you sell, and which suppliers matter?

market_analysis.description: Market size, growth, trends, and gaps the user provided. Do not add a market-size figure.
market_analysis.x-ask: What market size, growth, trends, or gaps do you want in the plan? Skip any number you do not have.

target_customer.description: Who the customer is. Do not invent customer names or demographic stats.

competitors.description: Competitors the user named, and the difference the user stated.
competitors.x-ask: Which competitors should the plan name, and how are you different from each?

difference.description: How the user's offer differs, in their words.

strengths.description: Strengths the user listed for a SWOT.
strengths.x-ask: What strengths should the SWOT include?

weaknesses.description: Weaknesses the user listed for a SWOT.
weaknesses.x-ask: What weaknesses should the SWOT include?

opportunities.description: Opportunities the user listed for a SWOT.
opportunities.x-ask: What opportunities should the SWOT include?

threats.description: Threats the user listed for a SWOT.
threats.x-ask: What threats should the SWOT include?

marketing_plan.description: Positioning, channels, tactics, and how results will be measured, only as the user described them.
marketing_plan.x-ask: How will customers find you, and how will you measure that?

operations.description: Suppliers, production, fulfillment, and inventory practices the user described, including backups they named.
operations.x-ask: How will you source, produce, store, and deliver what you sell?

starting_capital.description: Capital the business has now, as a number the user stated. Leave null when they did not give one.
starting_capital.x-ask: How much capital does the business have now? Say if you don't want a number in the plan.

funding_request.description: Amount of funding the user is requesting. Leave null when they are not raising or did not give a number.
funding_request.x-ask: How much funding are you requesting, and say if you are not raising?

use_of_funds.description: How the user will spend any funding they named.
use_of_funds.x-ask: If you are raising, how will you use the money?

financials.description: Revenue figures the user provided, one number per period. Omit the chart when this is null. Do not forecast years the user did not supply.
financials.x-ask: Which revenue figures should the chart show? Share the period labels, the series name, and one number per period, or say you have no figures yet.

series.description: Revenue numbers the user provided, one per label.

seriesName.description: Name of the series, such as Collected revenue.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the user explicitly asked to include. Projections in the plan must trace back to these or to supplied data.
assumptions.x-ask: Which assumptions should be labeled in the plan?

review_cadence.description: When the user wants the plan reviewed, such as quarterly or annually, and any earlier triggers they named.
review_cadence.x-ask: How often should this plan be reviewed?

missing_info.description: Required fields the user declined to answer. The agent fills this while validating.
missing_info.x-ask: Which required facts are you leaving unanswered?

text.description: A required fact that is still missing.
